metric_definitions.per_class_recall_iou50: Greedy one-to-one matching of same-class raster masks at mask IoU >= 0.50
metric_definitions.merge_rate: Predicted masks with >=25% coverage of at least two same-class GT masks / predictions
metric_definitions.duplicate_rate: Extra member of same-class predicted-mask pairs with IoU >= 0.70 / predictions
